**Description**
 What does it take to build a foundation model that can forecast demand for hundreds of millions of products — including ones that have never been sold before?
   

  

 At Amazon, our Demand Forecasting team is tackling one of the most ambitious challenges in applied time series research: building large\-scale foundation models that generalize across an enormous and diverse catalog of products, geographies, and business contexts. This is not incremental modeling work. We are redefining what's possible in demand forecasting.
   

  

 Our team operates at a scale that is unmatched in industry. We run experiments across millions of products simultaneously, pushing the boundaries of what foundation models can learn from vast, heterogeneous time series data. We are also exploring novel data generation techniques that augment our already unprecedented dataset — opening new frontiers in model generalization and forecasting for products with limited or no sales history.
   

  

 The models you build here will ship to production and directly influence hundreds of millions of dollars in automated inventory decisions every week, labor plans for tens of thousands of employees, and Amazon's financial outlook. Beyond operational impact, this team contributes to the broader scientific community and advances the state of the art in time series foundation models.
   

  

 If you are a scientist who wants to work at the frontier of time series research, at a scale no academic lab or startup can match, and see your work deployed to real\-world impact — this is the team for you.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Design and run rigorous experiments at scale to evaluate and improve foundation model performance across hundreds of millions of products, geographies, and business verticals
* Lead the end\-to\-end lifecycle of forecasting models — from research and experimentation through production launch — including defining success metrics, obtaining stakeholder sign\-off, and managing rollout
* Conduct online and offline labs to measure the real\-world impact of forecast improvements beyond accuracy, including downstream supply chain, inventory, and financial outcomes
* Develop and deploy production\-grade deep learning and statistical models using Python, Scala, SQL, and related tools
* Perform large\-scale exploratory data analysis to uncover patterns, identify opportunities, and inform model development
* Translate complex research findings into clear insights and recommendations for technical and non\-technical stakeholders at all levels
* Contribute to Amazon's scientific community and the broader research field through collaboration and publication in top\-tier venues


 A day in the life
   

  

 No two days look the same, but most will involve some combination of deep technical work, cross\-functional collaboration, and scientific thinking at a scale you won't find anywhere else.
   

  

 You might start the morning reviewing the results of an experiment running across hundreds of millions of products — analyzing whether a new foundation model variant is improving generalization on cold\-start items, or whether a novel data generation approach is meaningfully shifting forecast quality. You'll dig into the numbers, form a hypothesis, and design the next iteration.
   

  

 Later in the day, you could be in a stakeholder review, walking business and engineering partners through a set of launch metrics — explaining not just forecast accuracy, but the downstream supply chain and financial impact your model is driving. Getting a model to production at Amazon requires rigor: you'll define success criteria, run online and offline labs to validate real\-world impact, and build the case for sign\-off across technical and business stakeholders.
   

  

 You'll write code — Python, Scala, SQL — to process and analyze data at a scale most scientists never encounter. You'll collaborate closely with scientists, engineers, and business teams, and contribute to research that has a real chance of being published and advancing the field.
   

  

 The work is hard, the problems are unsolved, and the impact is immediate. If you want to do research that ships — this is where you do it.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The Demand Forecasting team sits at the heart of Amazon's supply chain, building the science that determines what products are available, when, and at what cost — for hundreds of millions of customers around the world. Our mission is to push the frontier of what's possible in large\-scale time series forecasting, and to deploy that science where it creates real, measurable impact.
   

  

 We are a team of scientists who care deeply about both research rigor and real\-world outcomes. We don't just publish — we ship. And we don't just ship — we measure, iterate, and raise the bar. Our work spans the full lifecycle: from foundational research and large\-scale experimentation to production deployment and downstream impact measurement across supply chain, inventory, and financial planning.

Notion’s AI platform is vital to helping product teams move faster with production\-grade guardrails as models, providers, and AI capabilities rapidly evolve.

 We have an exciting and rewarding opportunity for you to take your software engineering career to the next level.
   

  

 As a Software Engineer III at JPMorganChase within the Commercial \& Investment Bank \- Data Analytics team, you serve as a seasoned member of an agile team to design and deliver trusted market\-leading technology products in a secure, stable, and scalable way.  In this role, you will work alongside Data Scientists to build cloud\-based frameworks for hosting machine learning models, providing software engineering expertise throughout the model development lifecycle. You will leverage both internal and external cloud platforms, utilizing proprietary and open\-source tools to ensure models meet SDLC standards, are production\-ready, and can be deployed efficiently. * Mentor and coach junior and mid\-level engineers through code review, design review, pair programming, and structured knowledge sharing, helping the broader team grow in technical maturity and confidence over time

* Solid understanding of hardware\-software interaction at a low level
* Experience building large\-scale compute infrastructure (grid, cloud, HPC)

* Experience with data pipelines for design or characterization data

 As a Member of Technical Staff of talent experience, you'll own the shared backend architecture that underpins every user journey for talent network at Mercor.
   

  

 Mercor's products—talent matching, assessment, expert workflows—are growing faster than any single team can architect for. You'll define the technical direction of the systems they all depend on: core services, data models, APIs, and infrastructure patterns that must scale with a network of tens of thousands of experts and the demands of the world's leading AI labs. You'll set the standards that dozens of engineers build on, pay down the architectural decisions that no longer fit, and make the ones that will still be right three years from now.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on technical leadership role, not a management role. You'll write code, review the designs that matter most, and act as the connective tissue between product teams—partnering directly with engineering leadership to shape how the organization builds.

* Design systems for scale, reliability, and evolvability, and lead the highest\-stakes technical decisions and design reviews.
* Identify and pay down architectural debt that slows product teams, and lead complex cross\-team migrations.
* Establish backend engineering standards, patterns, and best practices adopted across all product teams.
* Stay hands\-on: prototype critical systems, ship production code, and unblock teams on their hardest technical problems.
* Mentor senior engineers and raise the technical bar across the engineering organization.
* Partner with engineering and product leadership on build\-vs\-buy decisions, platform investments, and technical hiring.

* Deep expertise in distributed systems, service architecture, data modeling, and API design at scale.
* A track record of owning architecture across multiple teams or an entire organization—and of decisions that aged well.
* Experience leading large, complex technical migrations in production without stopping the business.
* Strong opinions, loosely held: you drive alignment through technical judgment and clear writing, not authority.
* Fluent in using modern AI development tools (e.g. Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or similar) to improve engineering productivity.
* Experience mentoring senior engineers and raising the technical bar across an organization.
* Excellent communication skills—able to make complex tradeoffs legible to both engineers and leadership.
* High ownership, pragmatism, and a bias toward shipping.

**Job Summary:**
 The Associate Data Scientist will work closely with Opportunity Insights’ Founding Director, Executive Director, faculty, and senior researchers and staff to transform large administrative and program datasets into reproducible analyses, statistical models, and decision\-support tools. The position helps translate complex research findings into accessible metrics, visualizations, and reports for internal leadership and external partners, including policymakers and practitioners. This position will report to Raj Chetty, Opportunity Insights’s Founding Director.
   

  

**Job\-Specific Responsibilities:**
* Analyze large, complex administrative and program datasets in support of specific research projects, and contribute to the design, development, and enhancement of OI’s broader data infrastructure.
* Construct robust statistical models to produce statistics, such as those in the Opportunity Atlas, from confidential microdata, ensuring the application of appropriate privacy protection principles and compliance with data governance standards.
* Apply advanced statistical and econometric techniques for causal inference, including matching estimators and quasi\-experimental designs, to rigorously evaluate program impacts and economic mobility outcomes.
* Build, calibrate, and validate models for financial forecasting, social impacts, and other economic and social benefits, including demand estimation and policy impact analysis, to inform data\-driven decision\-making.
* Integrate analytical findings into well\-structured dashboards, reports, and visualizations for internal decision\-makers and external partners, ensuring clarity, accessibility, and alignment with stakeholder needs.
* Document methodologies, data transformations, and analytical workflows in a clear and reproducible manner, supporting transparency, knowledge transfer, and long\-term maintainability of OI’s analytical assets.

**Additional Qualifications and Skills:**
* Experience with data analysis, economics research, or econometrics
* Proficiency in Python and languages such as Stata or R for data analysis
* Experience with creation and analysis of large datasets

* Experience and interest in working in collaborative settings with other team members

**Job Description**
 The Embedded Software Engineer develops hardware, firmware, and graphical user interface (GUI) applications for use in both modular components and larger integrated systems. This role defines specifications and designs, develops, and documents firmware and software for ground\-based, airborne, and space\-qualified embedded systems. The engineer creates robust software architectures and technical specifications that support new product development and legacy product enhancement, contributing directly to products that reach the market quickly and reliably.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Design, develop, and implement firmware and software for embedded systems used in modules and larger integrated systems.
* Define technical specifications and software architectures for ground\-based, airborne, and space\-qualified embedded systems.
* Develop and maintain hardware, firmware, and GUI applications that interface effectively with embedded platforms.
* Work within bare metal and RTOS environments to implement efficient, reliable, and real\-time embedded software solutions.
* Program and debug embedded applications using C and C\+\+ in Linux and bare metal environments.
* Integrate and support communication interfaces such as RS\-232, RS\-422, RS\-485, and RF/radio technologies.
* Produce clear, thorough documentation for firmware, software, and system architectures, including specifications and design descriptions.
* Apply structured development practices, including Waterfall methodology, to plan, implement, and deliver embedded software projects.
* Collaborate closely with multiple engineering disciplines to support the design and operation of Solid State Power Amplifiers and related systems.
* Participate in the full product lifecycle, from concept and new product development through deployment and support of legacy products.
* Communicate effectively with cross\-functional teams to clarify requirements, resolve technical issues, and ensure alignment with project goals.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of embedded software design, coding standards, and documentation practices.


**Essential Skills**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science (BS CS) or a closely related field.
* In\-depth knowledge and hands\-on experience with C programming for embedded systems.
* In\-depth knowledge and hands\-on experience with C\+\+ programming for embedded systems.
* Strong experience developing software in bare metal environments.
* Experience working with Linux operating systems in an embedded context.
* Proficiency in developing firmware and software architectures for embedded systems.
* Experience with RTOS (Real\-Time Operating Systems) and microcontroller\-based development.
* Experience with serial communication interfaces such as RS\-232, RS\-422, and RS\-485\.
* Experience working with RF and radio\-related embedded applications.
* Strong documentation skills for specifications, designs, and embedded software artifacts.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills for collaboration and technical reporting.
* Experience applying Waterfall methodology or similar structured development approaches.


**Additional Skills \& Qualifications**
* Experience developing GUI applications that interface with embedded systems.
* Experience working on both new product development and legacy product support.
* Familiarity with designing or supporting Solid State Power Amplifiers or similar high\-frequency hardware systems.
* Ability to work effectively in multidisciplinary engineering teams.
* Demonstrated ability to bring embedded products from concept to market in a timely manner.


**Work Environment**
 The role operates in a collaborative engineering environment where you work closely with multiple disciplines, including hardware, RF, and systems engineers, to design and support Solid State Power Amplifiers and related embedded systems. You will work with modern embedded development tools, Linux\-based platforms, bare metal and RTOS environments, and serial communication interfaces such as RS\-232, RS\-422, and RS\-485, as well as RF and radio technologies. The organization emphasizes both new product development and enhancement of legacy products, offering the opportunity to see your work move quickly into the market and to play a major role in the overall product development process. The workplace culture is highly regarded, with a strong focus on employee experience and engagement, and is recognized as a great place to work by a significant majority of its employees.

 State Street’s DMC Technology organization delivers institutional\-grade custody, clearing, brokerage, and wealth management solutions to financial institutions, wealth managers, and broker\-dealers globally. As we continue to modernize and expand our digital platforms, we are investing in cloud\-native, API\-first, and data\-driven technologies that enable scalable growth, operational resilience, and exceptional client experiences.
   

  

 We are seeking a
 **Senior Full Stack Engineer** 
 to drive the design, development, and delivery of mission\-critical applications across the full technology stack. This role will play a key part in shaping our digital architecture, enhancing engineering practices, and accelerating the adoption of modern software development methodologies.
   

  

**Role Summary**
 As a senior technical leader within DMC Technology, you will architect, design, and develop enterprise\-scale applications spanning user experience, application services, APIs, and backend platforms. Operating at a Staff/Principal Engineer level, you will influence engineering strategy, solution architecture, and development standards across multiple teams and business domains.
   

  

 You will partner closely with Product, Architecture, Data, Security, Risk, and Business stakeholders to deliver highly scalable, secure, and resilient solutions that meet the demanding requirements of financial services and wealth management platforms.
   

  

**Core Responsibilities**

* Drive adoption of cloud\-native engineering practices, DevSecOps methodologies, and automated software delivery pipelines.

* Lead technical design reviews, architecture discussions, and code quality initiatives across engineering teams.
* Provide mentorship and technical leadership to engineers while promoting engineering excellence and continuous learning.
* Partner with Risk, Compliance, and Security teams to ensure solutions meet regulatory and audit requirements.
* Support modernization and transformation initiatives, including migration of legacy platforms to cloud\-native architectures.


**Required Experience**
* 12\+ years of software engineering experience, including significant experience building enterprise\-scale applications across frontend and backend technologies.
* Proven track record designing, developing, and operating highly available, mission\-critical systems within large enterprise environments.
* Strong experience building cloud\-native solutions on AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
* Hands\-on expertise developing RESTful APIs, microservices, and event\-driven applications.
* Deep experience implementing CI/CD pipelines, automated testing frameworks, and DevSecOps practices.
* Strong understanding of distributed systems, scalability patterns, performance optimization, and fault\-tolerant architectures.
* Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
* Proven ability to lead complex technical initiatives involving multiple stakeholders and cross\-functional teams.
* Experience mentoring engineers and driving engineering best practices across development organizations.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to balance business priorities and technical excellence.


**Domain Expertise – Wealth \& Financial Services**
* Strong understanding of wealth management, brokerage, custody, or financial services platforms.
* Familiarity with financial transactions, portfolios, investment products, and market data ecosystems.
* Experience building systems requiring high precision, auditability, and regulatory compliance.
* Understanding of securities processing, order management, trading workflows, or client servicing platforms.
* Experience supporting systems subject to regulatory and compliance requirements.
* Knowledge of financial data integration, reporting, and operational workflows is highly desirable.

**Backend Technologies**
* Java, Spring Boot, Spring Cloud
* REST APIs and Microservices Architecture
* Event\-Driven Architecture and Messaging Platforms (Kafka, MQ)
* Distributed Systems Design


**Frontend Technologies**
* React, Angular, or similar modern JavaScript frameworks
* TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3
* Responsive Web Design and Modern UI Frameworks


**Cloud \& DevOps**
* AWS (preferred), Azure, or GCP
* Kubernetes and Docker
* Terraform, CloudFormation, or Infrastructure as Code platforms
* CI/CD tools such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or GitLab


**Data Technologies**
* PostgreSQL, SQL Server, Oracle
* NoSQL databases such as MongoDB, DynamoDB, or Cassandra
* Caching technologies including Redis or similar platforms


**Engineering Practices**
* Agile and DevSecOps methodologies
* Automated Testing and Quality Engineering
* Application Monitoring and Observability
* Secure Software Development Lifecycle (SSDLC)


**Education**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related technical discipline.
* Equivalent practical experience will also be considered.

* Build institutional\-grade platforms that power global wealth and financial services businesses.

* Lead transformational initiatives that directly impact clients, revenue growth, and operational efficiency.
